name: opensafely/population-outcomes-burden-research
what_it_is: An OpenSAFELY study examining changes in rates of cardiometabolic and pulmonary events during the COVID-19 pandemic using NHS primary and secondary care records. Study-specific analytic code, not a reusable framework.
constraints: Must execute within OpenSAFELY secure server
notable_absences: No individual patient data in repo
